subject: Recap & next steps — hosted API pricing + peak throughput (NovaRetail)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novaretail.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@novaretail.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps — hosted API pricing + peak throughput (NovaRetail)

Hi Elena / Samir,

Great to chat today — thanks for walking us through the integration plan and the sample traffic. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can put a formal quote together: 

- Expected monthly token volume: please confirm a 30-day rolling average and a high-water month. On the call you mentioned a baseline of tens of millions and some seasonality — can you confirm a numeric range (e.g., 50M–120M tokens)?
- Peak TPS / concurrency profile: you said there are 2–3 minute bursts during peak hours. Can you confirm peak tokens/sec (or requests/sec + avg tokens/request)?
- Target unit economics: you mentioned a target budget / $ per 1M tokens. Please confirm target $/1M and whether you'd prefer month-to-month hosted or committed volume pricing.

Attached: a tiny CSV template (traffic-profile-request.csv) that helps us map token shape to concurrency and cost. Also attaching a 1st-pass SOW for expected scope (SOW-draft-v1.pdf) — it’s intentionally high level.

Next steps I propose:
1) You fill the CSV with a representative week (today + peak day) — Samir can drop it in reply.
2) We produce two hosted pricing options: month-to-month and a committed 3/6/12-month slab with burst allowances + burst TPS plan.
3) Internal ask: engineering will review the traffic to confirm whether we recommend Hosted API with burst credits or Redwood Dedicated for better sustained peak economics.

If you prefer a quick follow-up call to walk the CSV, happy to schedule 30 minutes tomorrow.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Elena Rossi <elena@novaretail.com>

Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — hosted API pricing + peak throughput (NovaRetail)

Thanks Stephanie — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming numbers from our side based on the ops team and telemetry: 

- Monthly token volume (expected): 60,000,000 – 90,000,000 tokens typical.
- High-water months (seasonal promo): we sometimes see 110,000,000 – 125,000,000 tokens for a 48–72 hour window.
- Peak TPS: sustained peak ~3,800 tokens/sec for 10–15 minute windows; short burst peaks up to ~5,200 tokens/sec for 1–3 minutes during promos.
- Unit economics target: we would like to stay around $12–$15 per 1M tokens (this is internal target range).
- Preference: we’d like to start with Hosted (no infra lift) and evaluate Dedicated if the sustained peak recommendations point that way.

I’ve populated the traffic-profile-request.csv with a representative week and included a sample peak day column. Please confirm receipt.

Elena Rossi
Head of Product Operations, NovaRetail
elena@novaretail.com | +1 (312) 555-0199
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Recap & next steps — NovaRetail numbers (they filled the CSV)

Folks — forwarding Elena's confirmation and the populated CSV. Key pieces to note: 60–90M typical, 110–125M high month, peak bursts to ~5.2k TPS. They prefer Hosted to start and want a target $12–$15 / 1M.

Suggested approach from AE:
- Draft two hosted pricing options: 
  A) Month-to-month (no commit): $15 / 1M tokens + tiered burst pricing; include 14-day ramp credits for onboarding.
  B) Commit slab: 100M/mo commit for 12 months at $13 / 1M tokens + built-in short burst capacity (up to 6k TPS for 5 minutes).

Engineering considerations: can the hosted runtime sustain 5.2k TPS bursts with auto-bursting without a Dedicated slot? If not, we should flag a hybrid recommendation (hosted + dedicated burst path).

Attachments for quote: SOW-draft-v1.pdf, traffic-profile-request.csv.

Can one of you take lead on the formal quote and outline any API concurrency / throttle guardrails in the SOW? Also please propose a line-item for a 30-day PO credit if they commit.

Thanks,
Steph
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 17:05:00 -07:00

Quick thoughts — good candidate for tiered hosted: 
- Month-to-month: $15 / 1M tokens, includes 2x baseline burst credits for onboarding (14 days).
- Committed 12-mo 100M/mo: $13 / 1M tokens; include guaranteed burst pool that can sustain 6k TPS for 5 minutes plus auto-fallback to a slightly lower-cost model variant if we hit sustained highs.
- Quote id: QUO-7421 (please use for finance/PO).
- Add-ons: 30-day PO credit (one-time) for signed 12-mo commit; premium SLA (99.9) as an opt-in line item.

For the SOW: include explicit throttle/circuit-breaker behavior, a recommended burst window, and ops-runbook contact. I can draft the pricing section and push to HubSpot.

—Karthik

Subject: Proposal options and next steps (NovaRetail)

Hi Elena / Samir — thanks for the quick turnaround on the CSV. Based on your numbers and internal review, here are two hosted options we can formalize into a quote (attached will be the SOW + pricing):

1) Month-to-month hosted (no commit)
  - Price: $15 / 1M tokens
  - Onboarding: 14-day ramp credits + monitoring setup
  - Burst: auto-bursting enabled, subject to fair-use limits

2) Committed hosted slab (recommended if you expect sustained growth)
  - Commit: 100M tokens / month, 12-month term
  - Price: $13 / 1M tokens on committed volume; overage rate tiered
  - Burst: guaranteed burst pool that can sustain 6,000 TPS for short windows (see SOW)
  - One-time 30-day PO credit on signed 12-mo commitment

Next steps:
- Confirm which option you prefer and whether to proceed with a formal quote (I’ll send QUO-7421 for your procurement).
- If approved, I’ll route the DocuSign link and our SOW (SOW-draft-v1.pdf) for signature and push a 30-day PO credit as a line item if you pick option 2.

If you want, we can also schedule a 20-minute runbook review with our reliability lead to discuss the burst window and fallback behavior.

Thanks — I’ll hold the quote until EOD Friday pending your preference.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
